$comment: The one list of credits on avd-ops.dev/credits.html, built by scripts/site/build-credits.mjs. Link upstream and say what we use it for in our own words; never restate the source. A license is what the repo's LICENSE file says, read on the date in 'checked'. Name a person only if they are a public contributor to these repos or have said yes. No partner, Nerdio or HCL tooling here (tests/site.test.mjs). Public sources only.

adopted.name: Azure Verified Modules
adopted.job: The Bicep modules the landing zone is built from (host pool, workspace, scaling plan, network, Key Vault and more)

adopted.name: Windows Desktop Optimization Tool (WDOT)
adopted.job: Image optimization, run at a pinned release with a reviewed profile. It supersedes VDOT, which has no license and stays prior art only

adopted.name: PSRule for Azure
adopted.job: Checks the templates against Well-Architected rules in CI

adopted.name: Well-Architected Reliability Assessment (WARA)
adopted.job: The rule engine for live reliability checks, in place of one of our own

adopted.name: Azure review checklists
adopted.job: The AVD checklist the assessment method maps its facts to, cited by short item ID

adopted.name: Azure Proactive Resiliency Library v2
adopted.job: Resiliency recommendations for AVD resources, read by WARA's collector

adopted.name: Azure Monitor Baseline Alerts
adopted.job: The AVD alert pattern the method uses as its monitoring reference

adopted.name: 2ndbrain
adopted.job: The knowledge base format and tooling (scripts/kb/, schemas, hooks) every family KB is built on, and the knowledge capture and handoff hooks the other repos run

tooling.name: Bicep
tooling.job: Infrastructure as code for every template

tooling.name: Pester
tooling.job: Unit tests, offline scenarios and template guards

tooling.name: PSScriptAnalyzer
tooling.job: PowerShell lint in every repo's CI

tooling.name: Gitleaks
tooling.job: Secret scanning before anything is pushed

tooling.name: marked
tooling.job: Renders the docs on this site from Markdown

tooling.name: MADR
tooling.job: The format of every decision record

tooling.name: Schibsted Grotesk
tooling.job: Display font of the design system, served from this site through its Fontsource package (site/assets/fonts/LICENSE)

tooling.name: Source Sans 3
tooling.job: Body font of the design system, served the same way

tooling.name: JetBrains Mono
tooling.job: Code font of the design system, served the same way

tooling.name: Fontsource
tooling.job: The npm packages the three fonts are taken from, unmodified

prior_art.name: Azure Virtual Desktop Landing Zone Accelerator
prior_art.why: Microsoft's broad accelerator covers other identity models and brownfield. avd-landing-zone stays narrow on purpose and points people there for what it leaves out

prior_art.name: Azure Resource Inventory (ARI)
prior_art.license: MIT in the repo; its PowerShell Gallery listing says otherwise
prior_art.why: The parity checklist for avd-current-state's inventory and diagram. We built our own for redacted, contract-shaped output, and reuse none of its code until the license question is settled

sources.name: Azure Virtual Desktop documentation
sources.use: How AVD behaves. Upstream wins on documented behavior; a real run wins on what happened

sources.name: Cloud Adoption Framework for AVD
sources.use: The assess, deploy and manage phases the family follows

sources.name: Well-Architected Framework for AVD
sources.use: The pillars and checklists behind the assessment's targets

sources.name: Microsoft FinOps guides and the FinOps toolkit
sources.license: Microsoft Learn content, link only; the toolkit is open source
sources.use: The FinOps Framework and FOCUS as Microsoft explains them, for cost assessment

references.text: Every source the family reads is pinned in avd-assess, each to a commit or a Learn page's git_commit_id, with the date it was read and short claims in our own words.

experts.text: The subject matter experts the knowledge base follows are chosen and scored by a published method, with evidence for every score.

give_back.title: Upstream asks
give_back.text: Gaps, API asks and docs fixes real runs found, each with its evidence, drafted and reviewed before a person files it upstream under their own account.

give_back.title: Observations that disagree
give_back.text: When a run disagrees with a published source, avd-assess records it with the evidence, and it joins the upstream list.

give_back.title: Lessons from real runs
give_back.text: Every failure tests didn't catch becomes a lesson and a guard, in public, for anyone hitting the same thing.

help_wanted.title: Close a method gap
help_wanted.text: Method we wrote only because no published source covers it. Know a source that does? Tell us and the gap retires.

help_wanted.title: Send baseline evidence
help_wanted.text: Measured results from your own lab that agree or disagree with a baseline. Aggregates only, no names or IDs.

help_wanted.title: Suggest an expert to follow
help_wanted.text: Someone who publishes deep, original work on AVD. They are scored by the same method as everyone else.

help_wanted.title: Not sure where it goes?
help_wanted.text: Open it in avd-ops and we will move it to the right repo. A bug or idea for one repo goes to that repo's issues, below.
